en.headline: CJ Hendry’s juju world at Pacific Place enters final weekend
en.dek: The free immersive installation featuring oversized characters, a room of more than 400 plush figures and Hong Kong-exclusive collectibles runs until Sunday 16 August.
body: The first large-scale presentation in Hong Kong of Australian artist CJ Hendry’s juju character enters its final weekend at Pacific Place in Admiralty, closing on Sunday 16 August.

Open daily from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m. at Garden Court on Level LG1 with free admission, the installation includes a sculptural juju Planet centrepiece, a room containing more than 400 plush figures, and an infinity-mirror display. The organisers said the experience was developed with creative production partner Pen & Paper.

A concurrent merchandise store offers Hong Kong-exclusive blind-box colourways inspired by the city’s urban energy, limited hidden editions, larger plush toys and accessory capsule machines. Pacific Place said the juju series is recognisable for its floppy ears and flower-decorated eye.
The presentation opened on 23 July and marks the largest local outing to date for the collectible character series.

zh.headline: 太古廣場CJ Hendry juju world本周末結束
zh.dek: 金鐘太古廣場沉浸式裝置免費開放至八月十六日，包括巨型角色、逾四百隻毛絨公仔空間及香港限定收藏品。
body: 澳洲藝術家CJ Hendry的juju角色在香港首個大型呈現，於金鐘太古廣場進入最後一個周末，展覽將於八月十六日星期日結束。
活動於LG1層Garden Court舉行，每日上午十時至晚上十時開放，免費入場。裝置包括juju星球雕塑中心、匯聚逾四百隻毛絨公仔的空間，以及無限鏡裝置。主辦方表示體驗由創意製作夥伴Pen & Paper共同打造。
同期禮品店提供香港限定盲盒配色、限量隱藏版、大型毛絨公仔及扭蛋配件。太古廣場指juju角色以垂耳及花朵點綴的眼睛為標誌。
展覽於七月二十三日開幕，是該收藏角色系列至今在本地規模最大的一次呈現。
